items.title: Atlantic Castle
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
The great mysteries about monsters and ocean kings have always existed, and now you can live with them! This great castle was home to great kings who ruled the ocean for all eternity.

+ Amazing castle
+ Many places to explore
+ By 4KS Studios And Street Studios

items.title: Mob Boss
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Mobs get bullied by players all the time, but who said that they were all weak? Those mob goons have leaders. The mob bosses are among us! You'd be lucky to avoid them.

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Big boss attire inspired by Minecraft mobs!

items.title: Street Samurai Teens
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
The coolest and fiercest teens have hit the streets! They're dark, edgy, red and dressed to impress! Match with your friends and be the most trendy and stylish in the crowd with these 10 streetwear skins! Embrace your inner samurai!

- 10 samurai inspired teens
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Mob Gamers
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Gamer Mobs! How could anything be better than that? Check out these awesome gamer mob outfits! These are neon-style outfits that are perfect for roleplay!

- Mob skins
- Neon
- By KA Studios

items.title: Anime Teens
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
With these skins you will feel like you're in your favorite anime.
Surprise your friends with these extraordinary anime skins.

-12 skins
-Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Fashion Aesthetic Mobs
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Come and have fun with these mobs!

- 12 Skins
- 1 Free skin
- By UnderBlocks

items.title: Sweets
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Do you got a sweet tooth? Then these skins present a solution to become some of your favorite treats! With these tasty skins you'll be sure to look like one of the sweetest Minecraft skins in the game! 

- 5 HD dessert skins!
- 1 free skin!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Cute Frog Teens
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Hop into the action with these stylish and iconic froggy hatted teen skins! Become the coolest with red, green, and blue frog skins in your city! Or just be simply cute while casually playing survival! 

- 10 froggy teen skins! 
- 1 free skin!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Dog Sled Racers
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Harness your pups, bundle up, and get ready to race! Speed fast through blizzards, mountains and ice caves with your friends as a team. 4 mushers and 16 race dogs to choose from. Lead the pack to victory and adventure! Download today!

items.title: Survival Under the Dome 2
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
You are stranded in an unbreakable dome with no escape and few resources... Even if you manage to break out of the dome, beyond it there is nothing other than an arid hostile desert environment! 

In this sequel, to stay alive, explore ancient castles and villages, collect loot, and make a safe shelter! Can you survive?

From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Anime Spies
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
Spy mode activated! Enter a world of subterfuge, espionage, and adventure as an anime spy! Role-play with your friends, spy on your enemies with high-tech gadgets, and explore dangerous worlds as one of ten secretive skins. One skin included for free.
From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Mask Party
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: With Halloween just around the corner, every monster is throwing a rocking party. Grab your best mask and join the masquerade. Can you blend in with the scariest monsters?

items.title: Cyberpunk Teens
items.creator: Meraki
items.description:
Step into a cyberpunk future immediately, with the right outfit of course. These cyberpunk teens have taken their connection to technology one step further and modified themselves to become cyborgs! The future is now and it’s looking great. 

- 10 cyberpunk teen skins 
- By Meraki

items.title: Archery Teens
items.creator: Meraki
items.description:
Ready your bows… Bullseye! These archery teens are the best sharpshooters in all of the Minecraft world, wielding their bows as easily as toys. Host archery competitions, challenge your friends and get perfect shots all while looking extra stylish! 

- 12 archery teen skins 
- By Meraki

items.title: Fancy Monsters
items.creator: Meraki
items.description:
Zombies! Demons! Ghosts! Wait... why are they dressed like that? It's because they're the Fancy Monsters! They're spooky but stylish, eerie but elegant, frightening yet formal. Dressed for any occasion, these fancy monster skins will guarantee you a good time. 

- 10 fancy monster skins
- by Meraki

items.title: Party Outfits
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Do you want to have the most dazzling outfits at the party? If so, this skin pack is perfect for you! Choose your favorite skin now and start shining at the party!

+ 14 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Galaxy Squad
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Getting ready to embark on a new space adventure with your squad? If so, this skin pack is perfect for you! Pick your favorite space themed skin now and start an intergalactic adventure!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Pirate Island
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description: Arrr me matey! You wake up and realize your crew is gone and your boat has crashed into an abandoned island. Salvage any materials you can find, and explore the entire island! There may be mysteries waiting to be found.

items.title: Free Fall Parkour
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
This is no ordinary parkour challenge, it's reversed! Start your challenge at the top of a huge tower and make your way down. And that's not all! When you reach the bottom, climb all the way up inside the tower and make it back to the top.

+ Encounter unique obstacles
+ Overcome traps and pitfalls
+ Collect cool wearables, powerups and trails
+ 4 jumpy HD skins

items.title: Emo Anime Teens
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description: Live like a rockstar with these super cool anime emo skins. Show your hardcore PVP skills in the arena with raging emotion.

items.title: Enderman Teens!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Upgrade your wardrobe with these vibrant and cool Enderman Teens skins!
Impress your friends with clothing inspired by the Enderman of Minecraft! 

+ 12 HD skins!
+ 1 free HD skin!
+ Includes Enderman teen boy and girl skins!

items.title: Boat Wreck
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
You are stranded! With limited resources, can you survive on a few tropical islands in the middle of nowhere?

- Detailed boat wreck
- Six custom tropical islands
- Custom oasis-style cabin

From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Cute Mushrooms
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
Fungi... cute AND deadly! With a unique twist on the common mushrooms found in your backyard, enter a world where everyone is a mushroom! Role-play with your friends, build your own mushroom-themed worlds, and get ready to embrace your new fantasy reality. One free mushroom included.
From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Tales of a Cave Hero
items.creator: UUUM
items.description:
In the world of Underworld Life Craft, explore the dungeon and venture through the ocean and the sky! 
Together with Karbon, save the princess and become a hero!

- Dungeon puzzles and new monsters
- Various obstacles
- A whole new gameplay experience! 

- Supervised by Karbon
- Built by Japan Crafters Union
